I will do almost what I did last season, only I will keep the plot clean and feed it a little better because this land is mine and I do not want it to run down. I can read the fertilizer bag and I have seen some farmers nearby get better roots when they use a small amount, but cash is still tight, so I will not put too much. I will use some manure if I can gather it, I will not irrigate because I depend on the rains here, and I will hire a few hands for the heavy work because I am not as strong as before.
